info.name: Pomodoro
info.summary: Pomodoro focus timer: pick an outstanding Deck card, run customizable focus/break cycles.
info.description:
A Pomodoro focus timer integrated into Nextcloud.
Features: * Import outstanding cards from Deck boards * Choose which card to focus on * Customizable focus and break durations per cycle * Set how many Pomodoro cycles complete the selected task * Notification when a focus or break period ends
info.author: Jokersmile
